thread:
sara: Heads-up — partnerships team proposed a gating checklist for ISV tooling sandboxes before marketplace listing. Putting draft here for quick alignment.
kevin: awesome, curious what the must-haves are vs nice-to-haves.
maria: must-haves: sandbox deploy + sample app, auth integration (oauth or api-key), telemetry hooks (span + cost tags), and a short e2e smoke test.
dmitri: agree. Also need a small perf baseline on our smallest dedicated SKU so we can list expected latency. Not full benchmark, just 95th p50 numbers.
sara: exactly. Proposed gating categories: 1) Security/compliance (KMS, secrets handling), 2) Functional (SDK + sample), 3) Observability (traces/metrics), 4) Billing + entitlements (metering hooks), 5) Docs + onboarding.
kevin: can we add an integration test for routing fallback? e.g., sandbox configured to hit gateway -> fallback to hosted model if capacity constrained. Quick script should do.
maria: yes — include a tiny harness script we can run during validation. Example command we expect partners to support:
```bash
curl -X POST https://partner-sandbox.example.com/run \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_KEY' \\n  -d '{"prompt":"hello","model":"redwood-lite"}'
```
olivia: re: docs: require a one-page quickstart + example snippet for our SDKs (python/js). That reduces back-and-forth later.
dmitri: timeline question — if partner completes this checklist, will Partnerships and Eng do a single 2hr intake review or staggered?
sara: plan: 1) Partnership triage + security quick check (1 business day), 2) Eng sandbox smoke run (2-3 business days), 3) Partner remediates if needed, 4) Final go/no-go. Total target 7 business days for small partners.
kevin: who owns the smoke run? Eng-ecosystem or partner eng?
maria: partner runs first, then Eng runs our harness in a dedicated sandbox account to verify. We'll provide a small verification repo.
partner-bot: reminder — sample-checker job queued: run-id 2026-03-10T15:02Z. Status: pending.
kevin: OK. For marketplace listing metadata we also need a simple compatibility table: supported models, required config, recommended quantization. That can be authoring work from Partner PM.
dmitri: don't forget legal: data residency statement if partner persists user inputs. Partnerships to collect vendor attestation.
sara: added. Also suggestion: require a minimal CI job in partner repo that runs our smoke script on PRs (keeps integration healthy). Nice-to-have but strongly recommended.
maria: Could we prefill a checklist template for partners? I'll draft and post in the partner onboarding doc.
olivia: I'll coordinate with UX on the marketplace listing template so it's easy to map fields.
kevin: quick decision: do we gate joint announcement on passing the sandbox cert or on marketplace listing? I'd prefer announcement only after pass.
sara: agreed — announcement = post-cert + legal signoff. Internal comms will still flag the integration earlier.
partner-bot: cert-run update: run-id 2026-03-10T15:02Z -> started.
maria: next steps: sara to share checklist + verification repo link. partners should have a single contact and an SLA for remediation timeline.
dmitri: I'll add a short perf probe script into the repo and a sample results schema we want back (p50/p95/tokens/sec).
sara: thanks all — I'll post the checklist in #partnerships and ping the first wave of ISVs. Closing loop here unless anyone objects.
kevin: sounds good :thumbsup:
partner-bot: cert-run update: run-id 2026-03-10T15:02Z -> completed (partial failures). See /ci/logs/2026-03-10-180999 for details.
marianote: (minor followup) can we add an accessibility check for the sample UI? small ask but helpful for enterprise customers.
sara: good call — adding an optional accessibility smoke check to nice-to-haves.
kevin: cool. I'll be on the intake review Tues 10-11am PT.
